description_en: Starts a database cutover for a database migration or synchronization task
description_zh: 该接口主要用于在数据库迁移或同步任务的数据库切换
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx start-switch-database --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-xxx --slink-task-id etx-szr2rr6i00000 --is-modify-endpoint true --src-main-connect-string rm-000000000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --dst-main-connect-string pxc-000000000.polarx.rds.aliyuncs.com --src-main-port 3308 --dst-main-port 3313 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartSwitchDatabase

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the import task
parameters.name: slink_task_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to modify the endpoint or port of the source or target instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否修改源或目标实例的连接地址/端口
parameters.name: is_modify_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the primary node of the source instance, which is typically the internal or public endpoint of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 源实例的主节点连接地址（通常是实例的内网或外网地址）
parameters.name: src_main_connect_string

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the primary node of the target instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例的主节点连接地址
parameters.name: dst_main_connect_string

parameters.help_en: The port number of the primary node of the source instance
parameters.help_zh: 源实例主节点的端口号
parameters.name: src_main_port

parameters.help_en: The port number of the target instance
parameters.name: dst_main_port
